nom: First Aid Beauty Acne Clearing Pads 2% Salicylic Acid Acne Treatment

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the pads helped control excess oil and clear acne without stripping the skin, and one reviewer with dry, sensitive skin suggests the formula suits oily skin better than dry skin.
segments.dry: Accounts from reviewers with dry skin diverge: one with dry, sensitive skin found the pads irritating and drying, while another with already-dry skin reports no added dryness or irritation.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers who identify as having sensitive skin report good tolerance, with no adverse reaction and no extra drying or redness, though a few experienced irritation, tingling, or dryness and advise against use for very sensitive or severely acne-prone skin.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report clearer skin and fewer breakouts, including reduced blackheads and body acne on the back and chest, often within one to several weeks of daily use; a few reviewers, however, report no noticeable difference in their acne even after weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: Reports on dryness are mixed: some reviewers, particularly those with sensitive or already-dry skin, describe the pads as drying or irritating, while many more, including some with dry skin, report no increase in dryness and describe the pads as non-drying, especially when followed by a moisturizer.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers report the pads reduced redness in acne-prone areas, and one reviewer with sensitive skin noted no extra redness after use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports the pads helped control excess oil alongside clearing acne.

aspects.libelle: Leaves skin feeling clean and refreshed
Pads feel under-saturated, may dry out

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I didn't really like the product. It did nothing for my break outs. I felt like it dried my face out and made my hands feel nasty when I touched them. I wouldn't buy these as I think they are a waste of money.

extraits.titre: Would recommend, but not for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: These pads seemed to clean my skin well. Definitely would recommend but not for sensitive skin girlies. These irritated my skin and left me feeling super dry. Id say these would be great for more oily skin types but not for dry sensitive skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product has been great for my oily summer skin. Ive been using this for over a month. It's helped get rid of existing acne and helped control oil on my skin. Which has helped cause way less acne. Its worked so well. I bought my teenage son his own. And it's tremendously helped his skin. It isn't too harsh. Doesn't strip the skin like some of these products do. Would definitely recommend for those who suffer with acne.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] When it comes to my skin care routine I am a lazy girl and this is so quick miss free doesn't take much time. One side of the pad is smooth. The other side is bumpy, which they claim to be exfoliating. The path is so moist that I end up using it on my back acne. My face is already dry, but this doesn't make it more dry and it doesn't irritate my skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] They're a solid, gentle option if you want convenience and mild acne control. I wouldn't use them if you have very sensitive skin or severe acne. I'm on the sensitive side and felt a temporary tingling and some mild dryness after use. What I love is that they are easy to use, travel-friendly, no need to pour liquid on a cotton pad. Also with it being a clean formulation with no parabens, sulfates, phthalates, artificial fragrance that's a huge seller for me! Around $30–34 for 60 pads, which can feel expensive for a daily-use product. I wouldn't love to check out more products from this brand.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great product! My teenage daughter scooped these right up and used them all. It can in the cutest pink jar. They worked great at reducing redness and acne prone areas. Will be purchasing again

After trying this product for a few weeks it didn't seem like it made much of a difference for my acne. But I enjoyed using it just for an overall feeling of freshness before applying my makeup and after.
